caps: Ram once fired | a *BRAHMASTRA* at a crow. | With a *BLADE OF GRASS.*
lines.tts: Ram once fired a Brahmastra at a crow. With a blade of grass.

caps: Welcome to *PART 4* | of the *RAMAYAN* series.
lines.tts: Welcome to part four of the Ramayan series.

caps: In the forest of *CHITRAKOOT,* | Ram and Sita | rested by the water.
lines.tts: In the forest of Chitrakoot, Ram and Sita rested by the water.

caps: A crow kept | pecking at *SITA.* | She threw a clod of earth.
It came back, | and clawed her | until she *BLED.*
lines.tts: A crow kept pecking at Sita. She threw a clod of earth. It came back, and clawed her until she bled.

caps: Ram woke | and saw the blood.
This was no ordinary crow. | It was *INDRA'S OWN SON.*
lines.tts: Ram woke and saw the blood. This was no ordinary crow. It was Indra's own son.

caps: Ram picked up | a *BLADE OF GRASS,* | and turned it into a *BRAHMASTRA.*
lines.tts: Ram picked up a blade of grass, and turned it into a Brahmastra.

caps: The crow fled, | through *ALL THREE WORLDS.*
His father Indra, the gods, | the sages: | *NO ONE* would shelter him.
lines.tts: The crow fled, through all three worlds. His father Indra, the gods, the sages: no one would shelter him.

caps: So he came back, | and fell at | *RAM'S FEET.*
lines.tts: So he came back, and fell at Ram's feet.

caps: A Brahmastra | can never be wasted.
So the crow gave up | his *RIGHT EYE,* | and Ram *SPARED* him.
lines.tts: A Brahmastra can never be wasted. So the crow gave up his right eye, and Ram spared him.

caps: Years later, in *LANKA,* | Sita told Hanuman this story,
a secret | *ONLY RAM* would know.
lines.tts: Years later, in Lanka, Sita told Hanuman this story, a secret only Ram would know.

caps: And she asked: | for a crow, a Brahmastra.
Why not for | the demon *WHO TOOK ME?*
lines.tts: And she asked: for a crow, a Brahmastra. Why not for the demon who took me?

caps: *NEXT, PART 5:* | one man against | *FOURTEEN THOUSAND* demons.
lines.tts: Next, part five. One man, against fourteen thousand demons.

caps: *FOLLOW* | so you don't miss it,
and comment | *JAI SHRI RAM!*
lines.tts: Follow, so you don't miss it, and comment, Jai Shri Ram!
